resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com calls the 1934 structure a camp; Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts call it a tent cabin. The story reports both.
firelookout.com gives 10,332 ft for the lookout; the TopoQuest Bowery Guard Station point is at 6,765 ft. No source ties the two places together, so the story reports both figures separately.

notes_for_editor: Three Bowery records exist: us-id-bowery (researched 2026-10-10, point from Idaho Fire Lookouts), us-id-bowery-2 (FFLA) and this one (Forest Lookouts Bowery G. S.). They look like duplicates to merge. The record point (43.9976, -114.5173) lies north-northwest of Ketchum, consistent with the firelookout.com bearing, so no location correction is proposed. The 1934 structure is a camp or a tent cabin depending on the source. The 10,332 ft elevation comes from firelookout.com only; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives no usable figure. The TopoQuest guard station point is about 3 km from the record's point, and no source connects it to the lookout. Staffing is omitted: Idaho Fire Lookouts reports no documented staffing history. Status is left as the record has it (unknown), since sources give no current condition. The earlier us-id-bowery record proposed status 'abandoned', which is not in the status list, so it is not used here. No photos added.
